guidance: Iter1 winner: plan3 (eco) WNS=-69.3ps (Δ-1.6ps) TNS=-1433.5ps (Δ-288.4ps) — REGRESSION. All 3 plans regressed WNS AND TNS; viol flat at 49. Decision: retry — re-seed from the original seed ODB (WNS=-67.8), do NOT promote any regressed state. Path structure unchanged, so the moves were counterproductive, not the objective.

WNS/TNS strategy for next iter: target WNS SURGICALLY on the single worst path (dpath.a_reg.out[4]$_DFFE_PP_ → resp_msg[13]). viol is moderate (49) but every broad move regressed TNS too, so breadth is not the problem — blanket sizing/vt is. Keep repair_tns LOW (0–20); use staged/ECO edits aimed at named cells, not a global vt_swap+sizeup sweep.

vt_swap is EXHAUSTED on the worst path: INVx2_SL, HAxp5_SL, OR2x2_SL, AO21x1_SL, OA211x2_SL, OA21x2_SL, OR5x2_SL are ALL already at _SL (fastest VT). A vt_swap-led plan has no headroom here and is why plan1/plan2 regressed. The ONLY VT headroom on the path is output41 (BUFx2_ASAP7_75t_L → swap to _SL); do not touch the _R clock buffers (CTS).

Stuck/unsizable cell: _590_ HAxp5_ASAP7_75t_SL — half-adder, CON delay 11.9ps + SN 7.4ps (~19ps total), only one size, cannot resize. Attack the load/slew around it: input A is fed by _312_ (INVx2_SL) with 10ps slew; output nets _046_/_047_ feed downstream. Reduce input slew (upsize/clone _312_) or lighten its output nets rather than touching the HA.

Self-inflicted bottleneck: buf_ha590_eco (BUFx4_ASAP7_75t_SL) inserted by the eco plan contributes 17.4ps while driving only 3.45fF (buf_ha590_eco_net161) — grossly over-sized for its load and adding delay. Right-size it DOWN (BUFx1/BUFx2) or remove it. This is an area+delay win and must precede adding any new cells.

Highest-load net on the path: _108_ off _331_ OA211x2_SL has output cap 5.85fF and Y delay 22.5ps. Reduce load via clone/net-split or a correctly-sized repeater (NOT another x4). Also _393_ OR5x2_SL contributes 23.1ps (5-input OR intrinsic delay, already _SL) — query the cell catalog for a stronger OR5 drive (e.g. OR5x4) as the only remaining structural lever there.

Area: sizeup-led plans regressed, so do NOT add area blindly. Lead with right-sizing the over-sized buf_ha590_eco and load-reduction on _108_ before inserting buffers. Default reference area is 52 um2; per-plan area was not provided this iteration.
avoid_strategies: vt_swap-led sequences (plan1 vt_swap,sizeup,swap / plan2 sizeup,vt_swap,swap) — worst-path cells are already _SL, no VT headroom, regressed both WNS and TNS.
sizeup-first / global sizeup — added load and cap, produced the largest regression (plan2 ΔWNS=-4.2).
Generic eco buffer insertion that drops oversized buffers (BUFx4 on a 3.45fF net like buf_ha590_eco) — adds more delay than it saves.
